content: google/uuid latest is v1.6.0 (2024-01-16; no newer release since). v1.6.0 fixed NewV7 monotonicity (PR #150) so same-millisecond v7 generation is safe under concurrency; includes Max UUID constant. NewV7 does NOT implement an HLC counter in rand_a the way sup-kv needs (it uses its own monotonic scheme); sup-kv RecordVersion packing stays in-repo per design.
